decisions.statement: An addon is named by the slug its page carries.
The folder an addon is built from is the folder its page sits in.
The name the game reads an addon by is the name that folder's manifest states.
A folder no addon manifest sits in refuses the deploy.
An addon is compiled before it is placed.
A compile that refuses leaves the game's folder as it was.
A dry run says where the addon is built from and what it is placed as.
What the compile said is answered beside what the placing said.
Nothing here is packed and nothing here leaves this machine.

definition: one ESO addon compiled and put where the game reads it
